abilities.desc_zh: 近距离轰出高浓缩玻璃瓦斯火箭弹，直接击碎敌方护甲，施加破甲削减 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒并击退。

abilities.desc_zh: 极度敏感多疑的性格让他在面对高爆发敌人时神经紧绷，闪避几率提升 {{var_2}}，且受到暴击时立刻后撤步脱离连招。
abilities.desc_en: Constant suspicion grants {{var_2}} Evade chance. When struck by a Critical Hit, immediately performs an evasive backdash.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程命中使敌人神经紊乱，降低其能量获取率 {{var_3}} 并施加持续脑震荡 (Concussion)。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged hits disrupt enemy nervous circuits, decreasing Power Flow by {{var_3}} and inflicting Concussion.

abilities.desc_zh: 当被逼入绝境（生命值低于 40% 或遭受暴击）时，暴怒爆发，获得不可阻挡持续 4 秒，攻击必定破防。
abilities.desc_en: When pushed into a corner or below 40% Health, enters paranoid frenzy gaining Unstoppable for 4s with unblockable hits.

abilities.desc_zh: 快速后跳射出高频震颤破片弹，打断对手并施加震荡，使对手在 {{var_1}} 秒内无法触发任何暴击。
abilities.desc_en: Fires a high-frequency concussion grenade, interrupting the opponent and disabling their Critical Hits for {{var_1}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 以不可预测的漂移轨迹狂野冲撞对手，施加破甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒，降低其 {{var_3}} 护甲评级。
abilities.desc_en: Performs an erratic drift charge, inflicting Armor Break for {{var_2}} seconds and reducing Armor by {{var_3}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 彻底陷入神经失控，疯狂撞击并将对手轰上天际，造成 {{var_4}} 伤害并使对手眩晕 {{var_5}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Succumbs to total madness, violently ramming the enemy dealing {{var_4}} damage and stunning them for {{var_5}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗开始时获得 {{var_4}}~{{var_5}} 初始能量与 +{{var_6}} 攻击力和护甲。仅当队伍中所有成员均具有此协同（飞虎队全员）时激活。
abilities.desc_en: Start the fight with {{var_4}}~{{var_5}} Power and +{{var_6}} Attack & Armor. Bots only benefit if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: 与横炮、飞毛腿对抗时，获得 +{{var_7}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_7}} Critical Damage against Sideswipe or Sunstreaker.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_8}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_8}} Critical Rating.

starscream_ghost_gs.note: 经典G1 侦查系 [特性: 鬼魂侦查系，全时悬浮飞行与高额暴击]
starscream_ghost_gs.desc_zh: 在被惊破天的巨炮化为灰烬后，红蜘蛛那不可磨灭的火种怨念化作不死鬼魂游荡在宇宙之间。拥有穿透实体防御的幽能，以及鬼魅般的全时悬浮飞行机动。

abilities.desc_zh: 全时处于悬浮鬼魂形态，所有近战与远程攻击对其有 30% 几率直接穿透虚化 (Miss)，不造成伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Hovering perpetually in spirit form gives a 30% chance for all incoming attacks to phase harmlessly through him (Miss).

abilities.desc_zh: 射线直接作用于敌方火种，造成无视护甲与护盾的纯净真实伤害。暴击率极高。
abilities.desc_en: Null-Rays strike the opponent Spark directly, inflicting pure True Damage bypassing all Armor and Shields with high Critical Chance.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到暴击时免疫额外暴击加成伤害；每次成功虚化闪避时，吸取对手 10% 能量槽。
abilities.desc_en: Immune to extra Critical Damage bonuses. Phasing through incoming attacks siphons 10% of opponent Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到致命伤害时，红蜘蛛化作怨灵附身对手 5 秒，令其陷入混乱反噬，并在附身结束时满血复活！
abilities.desc_en: Upon taking fatal damage, possesses the opponent for 5s dealing continuous backlash before resurrecting in ghost form!

abilities.desc_zh: 潜入虚空从背后突刺，造成无视格挡的暴击并施加破甲，削减对手 {{var_1}} 护甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Phases into the void and strikes from behind with unblockable Critical damage, reducing Armor by {{var_1}} for {{var_2}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 双手抓住对手头部强行抽取火种能量，对目标施加虚弱降低其 {{var_3}} 攻击力持续 {{var_4}} 秒，同时自身恢复 {{var_5}} 生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Siphons Spark energy, inflicting Weakness reducing Attack by {{var_3}} for {{var_4}}s and repairing {{var_5}} Health.

abilities.desc_zh: 释放万千怨魂与幽冥鬼火，使对手陷入混乱持续 {{var_6}} 秒，无法获取能量并在期间受到 {{var_7}} 持续伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Releases vengeful spirits, confusing the foe for {{var_6}}s, halting power gain, and dealing {{var_7}} continuous damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 与惊破天、威震天对决时，获得 +{{var_1}} 暴击率与暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Critical Rating and Critical Damage against Galvatron or Megatron.

abilities.desc_zh: 与滑流同队时，闪避几率额外提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Evade Chance when teamed with Slipstream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Critical Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 侧滑与闪避产生高频震荡波，打断敌方射击瞄准并击退对手。
abilities.desc_en: Sidesteps and dodges produce hypersonic shockwaves that disrupt enemy targeting and push them back.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗前 15 秒移动速度与暴击率提升 40%；生命值低于 30% 时闪避几率暴增 50%。
abilities.desc_en: Gains +40% speed and Critical Rating during the first 15s of battle; below 30% Health, Evade chance surges by +50%.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲锋俯冲与重击具有霸体特性，必定造成重度眩晕与强力破盾。
abilities.desc_en: Dive-bombs and Heavy Attacks gain Unstoppable and guarantee heavy Stun against enemy shields.

abilities.desc_zh: 垂直起降涡轮喷出高压气流吹飞敌人，造成音爆硬直并使目标眩晕 {{var_1}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Directs VTOL thruster blasts at the foe, blowing them away with a concussive blast and stunning for {{var_1}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 低空超音速掠过连续投弹扫射，命中造成破甲持续 {{var_2}} 秒，降低对手 {{var_3}} 护甲。
abilities.desc_en: Makes a low-altitude supersonic bombing pass, inflicting Armor Break reducing Armor by {{var_3}} for {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 突破五倍音速用坚硬的锥头穿刺敌人，造成巨额暴击伤害并施加脑震荡持续 {{var_4}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Breaches Mach 5, piercing the foe with his conehead, dealing massive Critical damage and inflicting Concussion for {{var_4}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 与挽歌、喷气机同队时，闪避与近战穿透提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Evade and Melee Piercing when teamed with Dirge or Ramjet.

abilities.desc_zh: 喷射大范围剧毒酸雾，造成酸蚀破甲，降低敌方 {{var_1}} 护甲并致盲对手 {{var_2}} 秒。

abilities.desc_zh: 机翼旋涡卷起酸液风暴，对敌方施加强酸，在 {{var_3}} 秒内造成 {{var_4}} 伤害，并降低其 {{var_5}} 攻击速度。
abilities.desc_en: Spins into an acidic whirlwind, inflicting Acid Burn dealing {{var_4}} damage over {{var_3}} seconds and reducing attack speed by {{var_5}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 升空降下灭世酸雨天幕，对敌方施加永久酸蚀，削减其 {{var_6}} 护甲并在 {{var_7}} 秒内造成 {{var_8}} 持续腐蚀伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ascends to trigger an acid rainstorm, melting {{var_6}} Armor and dealing {{var_8}} persistent damage over {{var_7}} seconds.

lifeline_gs_deluxe2014.desc_zh: 回春手是帕拉德隆星上硕果仅存的医官。从火种深处来说，她是一位绝对的和平主义者，对暴力的厌恶甚至让她在救治士兵时感到不安——因为她深知，一旦将伤员治愈，他们又将被重新送回残酷的战场。然而她绝非软弱之辈；她那敏锐而务实的理性，让她能够在面对毫无生还希望、徒增痛苦的伤员时，毫不犹豫地为他们执行安乐关闭程序。

abilities.desc_zh: 远程射击与暴击命中时为自身累积纳米修复充能，暴击时对敌方施加触电 (Shock)，造成持续能量伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged attacks and Critical Hits generate Nano Repair charges. Critical Hits inflict Shock on the opponent dealing Energy Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 当单次受到超过自身生命上限 10% 的伤害时，立刻生成吸收相当于 {{var_1}} 伤害的纳米护盾，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Taking damage exceeding 10% of Max Health instantly activates a Nano Shield absorbing {{var_1}} damage for 6 seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 自身生命值低于 50% 时激活再生程序，8秒内修复 {{var_2}} 生命值；净化自身身上的所有流血 (Bleed) 与酸蚀 (Acid) 减益。
abilities.desc_en: When Health drops below 50%, activates Triage Protocol to repair {{var_2}} Health over 8 seconds and Purify all Bleeds and Acid debuffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到持续伤害 (Damage-over-Time) 效果时，持续时间缩短 50%，并将受到的 DOT 伤害转化为自身的能量获取率。
abilities.desc_en: Damaging Debuffs have their duration reduced by 50%. Lifeline converts incoming DOT damage into increased Power Flow.

abilities.desc_zh: 战斗濒死时（生命低于 20%），触发核心紧急重启，恢复 {{var_3}} 生命值，并获得无敌力场，免疫下一次致命伤害持续 5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Upon dropping below 20% Health, triggers Core Restart repairing {{var_3}} Health and granting an Invulnerability Barrier preventing death for 5 seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 精准发射手术激光切割目标，净化自身所有减益，并根据净化的减益数量造成额外纯净能量伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Lifeline fires a precision surgical beam, purifying all personal debuffs and inflicting bonus energy damage per debuff removed.

abilities.desc_zh: 贴身释放高压除颤电极脉冲，对敌方造成触电在 {{var_1}} 秒内造成 {{var_2}} 伤害，并眩晕对手 {{var_3}} 秒，同时自身修复 {{var_4}} 生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Discharges defibrillator pulses, inflicting Shock dealing {{var_2}} damage over {{var_1}}s, stunning for {{var_3}}s, and repairing {{var_4}} Health.

abilities.desc_zh: 全功率激活帕拉德隆医疗矩阵，击飞敌人的同时自身获得持续修复协议，在 {{var_5}} 秒内恢复 {{var_6}} 生命值，并生成吸收 {{var_7}} 伤害的纳米护盾。
abilities.desc_en: Unleashes the full power of the Paradron Medical Matrix, blasting the foe away and granting herself continuous repair of {{var_6}} Health over {{var_5}}s and a Nano Shield absorbing {{var_7}} damage.
